svg.title: Visitor trips: From the United States
svg.desc: Three separate geographies, not a regional total. Missing observations and definition changes are not connected.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Sources: Hong Kong Tourism Board; Macao Government Tourism Office / DSEC; China National Bureau of
Statistics / Ministry of Culture and Tourism. Hong Kong: residence through 2022, nationality from 2023.
Macau: travel-document issuing place (residence before April 2015). Trips, not people. Missing years and
definition changes stay unconnected. MGTO: commercial reuse permission unverified.
